_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: Quick confirm now that it's hardened: on Team & RACI, unlock with the phrase (cpl-team-2026), post an update or set a RACI cell, reload — it should stick (the 401 is fixed). Then, signed in as a reviewer, try the new ⚙ Manage team phrase button to view/change the phrase. Have Malone confirm a save works on his side too.

Scroll below the RACI matrix to the 🚀 Mission Control board (collapsible). Review the 'Lift Off' plan with Malone — owners + the 3 decision branch points (owner accounts / auto-merge policy / GitHub tier). It's editable live once you unlock.
When you have time, skim docs/co_platform_strategy.md — the long-term plan to scale COBI + the CPL KB into a governed, CO-wide platform. Ends with a scorecard against all ~14 of your asks.

On the public CPL Fact Sheet, sign in and ✎ Curate: edit/move/add/delete boxes (incl. Vet Sprint & CPL Bump), reorder & hide the KPI cards, hide the budget table; every grid has its own ＋Add box. Try the ⬇ Word button next to Print.

3 small number-consistency items on the Fact Sheet I flagged but did NOT change (live/snapshot data or your call): '12 program areas' vs 13 rows; could-adopt 116 (deduped) vs per-area rows summing to 454; '30,000' (Phase-1 JST goal) vs '34,000+' vets. Say the word and I'll reconcile any.
One-time: add the Fact Sheet URL (or …/cpl-project-tracker/**) to the Supabase Auth → Redirect URLs list so a direct magic-link sign-in from the Fact Sheet lands back on that page.
Skim the Annual Report draft — it auto-assembles from live data + the latest posted status updates; tweak any section in place, then ✨AI-polish / ⬇Word / 🖨Print.
Review and merge public Knowledge Base PR #15 (Veterans plans) when you have a moment — it's been waiting on your sign-off.
Continue the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint per the scope doc — staging-cleanup pass, dry-run first, alias map committed.
Build the TMC Phase-2 acceptance engine (the CO-review scoring that decides whether a college's submitted courses meet each ADT's requirements).
Stand up the CPL-Assistant CCR/CER recommender ETL so the assistant can suggest the right course/credential a college could adopt.
